description: This file declares the DeviceHandler class and its factory, which manage WebSocket-based device interactions within the WebRTC operator component of the project. It includes methods for handling device registration, messaging, and connection lifecycle, as well as dependencies on device registry, server configuration, signal handling, and WebSocket handling.

classes.name: DeviceHandler
classes.description: Manages WebRTC device interactions, including registration, messaging, and disconnection handling.

classes.name: DeviceHandlerFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating DeviceHandler instances for WebSocket connections.

methods.name: device_info
methods.description: Returns the current device information as a JSON value.

methods.name: RegisterClient
methods.description: Registers a new client handler and returns its assigned client ID.

methods.name: SendClientMessage
methods.description: Sends a message to a specific client identified by client ID.

methods.name: OnClosed
methods.description: Handles cleanup when the WebSocket connection is closed.

methods.name: handleMessage
methods.description: Processes incoming messages based on their type.

methods.name: HandleForward
methods.description: Handles forwarding messages to other components.

methods.name: DeviceHandlerFactory
methods.description: Creates DeviceHandler instances for new WebSocket connections.

methods.name: Build
methods.description: Constructs a new WebSocketHandler for a given WebSocket connection.
